content.text: : myocardial oxygen demand exceeds oxygen supply

•results when a fixed coronary plaque prevents sufficient blood supply through a coronary artery at times of increased O2 demand, resulting in predictable chest discomfort during times of physical or emotional stress
•total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, triglycerides, glucose (A1C), creatinine, hematocrit
: examine for DM & renal disease (including microalbuminuria)
: hyperthyroidism can aggravate angina, hypothyroidism can lead to atherosclerosis
CRP >3mg/L is an independent risk factor for myocardial ischemia
HTN, diabetes, ↓ LVEF <40%, chronic kidney disease
: indicated if beta blockers are contraindicated, poorly tolerated, or ineffective
: anti-anginal medication, useful for pts w/ chronic angina despite standard medical therapy
